title: Where AP2 sits among the eight protocols
caption: Solid lines are documented links: UCP embeds AP2 as an extension, a2a-x402 nests x402 inside AP2 v0.1 mandates, and Verifiable Intent shares AP2's mandate types and now sits with it at FIDO. Dotted lines mark analogies, examples or protocols that the AP2 repository does not mention: at commit e1ea56d, unchanged as of 2026-10-21, it does not mention TAP, ACP, Shared Payment Tokens, the Machine Payments Protocol or ERC-8004. ERC-8226 is agnostic to the agent identity system and gives ERC-8004 only as an example.
alt: Flowchart. UCP embeds AP2 through the extension dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate. AP2 links to x402 through the a2a-x402 Embedded Flow, which targets AP2 v0.1. AP2 and Mastercard Verifiable Intent share vct values with different constraint prefixes. The FIDO Alliance governs AP2 specification work and also received Verifiable Intent. AP2 samples run over A2A. ERC-8226, a draft on-chain mandate standard, is an analogue that does not reference AP2; it is agnostic to the agent identity system and names ERC-8004 as one example of an agent registry. The AP2 repository does not mention Visa TAP, OpenAI ACP or the Machine Payments Protocol from Stripe and Tempo.
